data.name: TwoFactorEnforcementDescription
data.value: Require authenticator-app 2FA for admin users. When enabled, admins who have not set up 2FA will be redirected to enroll before accessing administrative features.

data.name: Require2FAForAdminsDescription
data.value: Controls which admin-level users must enroll in authenticator-app 2FA (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, etc.).

data.name: Require2FAAllAdmins
data.value: Department Admins + Managing User + Group Admins

data.name: Require2FACannotEnableNoManagingUser2FA
data.value: Cannot enable 2FA enforcement: the managing user of this department does not have two-factor authentication enabled on their account. The managing user must enable 2FA before this setting can be turned on.

data.name: Require2FACannotEnableNoCurrentUser2FA
data.value: Cannot enable 2FA enforcement: you do not have two-factor authentication enabled on your own account. You must enable 2FA before you can require it for others.

data.name: Require2FABothMustEnable
data.value: Cannot enable 2FA enforcement: neither you nor the managing user have two-factor authentication enabled. Both must enable 2FA before this setting can be turned on.

data.name: Require2FASettingLocked
data.value: This setting is locked until the above conditions are met.

data.name: PermOptionNotSavedManageWorkflowCredentials
data.value: Not saved: Department Admins edit, everyone can see names

data.value: Not saved: everyone can view, Department Admins cancel

data.name: SecurityDescription
data.value: Here you can set the permissions for your department, for example which users or roles can create calls, or who is authorized to create and remove users. Changes to the permissions will take effect on the next login to the Resgrid web application.

data.name: PermAddUsersNote
data.value: This option determines who can add users/personnel to the department. By default only Department Administrators (and the managing member) can add users. But Group Admins can also be allowed to add users (limited only to the group they are an admin of).

data.name: PermRemoveUsersNote
data.value: This option determines who can remove users/personnel from the department. By default only Department Administrators (and the managing member) can remove users. But Group Admins can also be allowed to remove users (limited only to the users in the group they are an admin of).

data.name: PermCreateCallNote
data.value: This option determines who can manually create calls from the Resgrid system. By default Everyone can create calls.

data.name: PermDeleteCallNote
data.value: This option determines who can delete calls from the Resgrid system. By default Everyone can delete calls.

data.name: PermCloseCallNote
data.value: This option determines who can close calls from the Resgrid system. By default Everyone can close calls.

data.name: PermAddCallDataLabel
data.value: Who can Add Data To Calls

data.name: PermAddCallDataNote
data.value: This option determines who can add data; like images, notes and files, to calls from the Resgrid system. By default Everyone can add data to calls.

data.name: PermCreateTrainingNote
data.value: This option determines who can create trainings. By default only Department Admins can create trainings.

data.name: PermCreateDocumentNote
data.value: This option determines who can add documents. By default Everyone can add documents.

data.name: PermCreateCalendarEntryNote
data.value: This option determines who can create calendar entries. By default Everyone can create calendar entries.

data.name: PermCreateNoteNote
data.value: This option determines who can create notes. By default Everyone can create notes.

data.name: PermCreateLogNote
data.value: This option determines who can add log entries. By default Everyone can add log entries.

data.name: PermCreateShiftNote
data.value: This option determines who can create and edit shifts. By default only Department Admins can create and edit shifts.

data.name: PermViewPersonalInfoNote
data.value: This option determines who can view personal information (PII) about personnel in the system. For example: Email Address, Phone Numbers, etc. By default Everyone can view this information.

data.name: PermAdjustInventoryNote
data.value: This option determines who can adjust inventory levels in the system. Until a value is saved, only Department Admins can adjust inventory.

data.name: PermViewPersonnelLocationLabel
data.value: Who can see the Location of Personnel

data.name: PermViewPersonnelLocationNote
data.value: This option determines who can see the location of personnel on the maps. To lock the option to just group admins and roles within a group you need to check the Group Only option.

data.name: PermViewUnitLocationLabel
data.value: Who can see the Location of Units

data.name: PermViewUnitLocationNote
data.value: This option determines who can see the location of units on the maps. To lock the option to just group admins and roles within a group you need to check the Group Only option.

data.name: PermCreateMessageNote
data.value: This option determines who can create and send messages (in-system mail). By default everyone can create and send messages.

data.name: PermViewGroupsUsersNote
data.value: By default all users can see all other users in the system. This option allows you to limit who can see users in the system.

data.name: PermViewGroupsUnitsNote
data.value: By default all users can see all units in the system. This option allows you to limit who can view units in the system.

data.name: PermViewContactsNote
data.value: By default all users can see all contacts in the system. This option allows you to limit who can view contacts in the system. If a user cannot view Contacts they also won't be able to add them to a call.

data.name: PermEditContactsLabel
data.value: Who can edit or create Contacts

data.name: PermEditContactsNote
data.value: By default all users can create and edit contacts in the system. This option allows you to limit who can create or edit contacts in the system.

data.name: PermDeleteContactsNote
data.value: By default all users can delete contacts in the system. This option allows you to limit who can delete contacts in the system.

data.name: PermCreateWorkflowNote
data.value: This option determines who can create, edit, and delete workflows and workflow steps. Until a value is saved, only Department Admins can manage workflows and every member can view them; saving any value also limits who can view them.

data.name: PermManageWorkflowCredentialsNote
data.value: This option determines who can create, edit, and delete encrypted credentials used by workflow actions (e.g., SMTP passwords, API keys). Until a value is saved, only Department Admins can manage credentials and every member can see their names; saving any value also limits who can see them.

data.name: PermViewWorkflowRunsNote
data.value: This option determines who can view workflow execution history, run logs, and health dashboards. Until a value is saved, every member can view workflow runs and only Department Admins can cancel or clear them; saving another value limits who can view them, and saving Everyone lets every member cancel and clear runs too.

data.name: SsoSingleSignOnDescription
data.value: Allow department members to log in with their existing corporate identity (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace, etc.) instead of a separate Resgrid password.

data.name: SsoOidcDescription
data.value: OIDC — Modern protocol, ideal for Entra, Okta, Auth0, Google

data.name: SsoSamlDescription
data.value: SAML 2.0 — Widely supported by government & enterprise IdPs

data.name: SsoScimDescription
data.value: Automatically sync users from your identity provider. When you onboard or offboard staff in your corporate directory, Resgrid reflects those changes automatically — no manual invite/remove steps.

data.name: SsoScimAutoCreate
data.value: Auto-create new members when added in your IdP

data.name: SsoScimSyncNames
data.value: Keep names & email addresses in sync

data.name: SsoSecurityPolicyDescription
data.value: Enforce department-wide compliance controls alongside SSO:

data.name: SsoSecurityPolicyRestrictLogin
data.value: Restrict login to SSO only (disable passwords)

data.name: SsoSecurityPolicyIpRestrict
data.value: Limit logins to specific IP CIDR ranges

data.name: SsoDiscoveryUrlCalloutDescription
data.value: The Resgrid mobile app uses this URL to discover your SSO settings before showing the login screen. Share it with your mobile team if needed.

data.name: SsoNoConfigurationsWarning
data.value: No SSO configurations yet. Use the buttons above to add OIDC or SAML 2.0.

data.name: SsoDeleteConfirmMessage
data.value: Are you sure you want to delete the {0} SSO configuration? This cannot be undone.

data.name: SsoErrorConfigAlreadyExists
data.value: An SSO configuration for {0} already exists. Use Edit to modify it.

data.name: SsoErrorOidcAuthorityInvalid
data.value: OIDC authority must be a valid HTTPS URL.

data.name: SsoErrorSamlCertificateRequired
data.value: An IdP signing certificate is required to validate SAML assertions.

data.name: SsoErrorIdpSsoUrlInvalid
data.value: The IdP single sign-on URL must be a valid HTTPS URL.

data.name: SsoEditProviderTypeOidcOption
data.value: OIDC (OpenID Connect) — Microsoft Entra, Okta, Google, Auth0

data.name: SsoEditEnableDescription
data.value: Only one configuration per provider type is active at a time.

data.name: SsoEditAllowLocalLoginDescription
data.value: When checked, users can still log in with username & password in addition to SSO. Disable this together with the Security Policy's Require SSO flag to enforce SSO-only login.

data.name: SsoEditAutoProvisionDescription
data.value: Automatically create a Resgrid account when a user authenticates via SSO for the first time and no matching email is found. Leave off to require manual invitation first.

data.name: SsoEditScimEnableDescription
data.value: Allows your IdP to automatically create/update/deactivate members. After saving, go to the SCIM Setup page to generate a bearer token.

data.name: SsoEditDefaultRankDescription
data.value: Optional. Applied only when Auto-Provision creates a new member.

data.name: SsoEditOidcInfoAlert
data.value: Where to find these values: In your IdP, register Resgrid as a Public Client (PKCE, no client secret required for mobile) or Web App (with secret for server-side flows). Copy the Client ID and Issuer URL from the registered application.

data.name: SsoEditAuthorityDescription
data.value: Examples: Entra ID: https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant-id}/v2.0 | Okta: https://{your-domain}.okta.com/oauth2/default | Google: https://accounts.google.com

data.name: SsoEditClientIdDescription
data.value: The public client identifier assigned by your IdP. Safe to display — not a secret.

data.name: SsoEditClientSecretDescription
data.value: Encrypted at rest using your department-specific key. Leave blank if using PKCE (mobile/SPA — no secret needed).

data.name: SsoEditClientSecretKeepExisting
data.value: Leave blank to keep the existing secret unchanged.

data.name: SsoEditSamlInfoAlert
data.value: Where to find these values: In your IdP, create a new SAML application. Enter the SP Entity ID and ACS URL shown below into your IdP, then paste the IdP metadata URL or certificate back here.

data.name: SsoEditSpEntityIdLabel
data.value: SP Entity ID (enter this into your IdP)

data.name: SsoEditAcsUrlLabel
data.value: ACS URL (Assertion Consumer Service — enter this into your IdP)

data.name: SsoEditAcsUrlNote
data.value: This URL uses an encrypted department token — never exposes your plain department code.

data.name: SsoEditEntityIdEditableNote
data.value: Must match exactly what you entered in the IdP.

data.name: SsoEditMetadataUrlNote
data.value: Resgrid will periodically fetch this URL to stay up to date with IdP certificates.

data.name: SsoEditAcsUrlStoredNote
data.value: Auto-filled from the generated URL above. Modify only if you configured a different ACS URL in your IdP.

data.name: SsoEditOidcBrokerRedirectLabel
data.value: Redirect URI for sign-in started from Resgrid (enter this into your IdP)

data.name: SsoEditOidcBrokerRedirectNote
data.value: Add this alongside any redirect URI you already registered; older Resgrid app versions keep using theirs.

data.name: SsoEditOidcAppRedirectLabel
data.value: Redirect URIs for sign-in in the Resgrid apps (enter each into your IdP)

data.name: SsoEditOidcAppRedirectNote
data.value: Each app, and each app's web edition, returns to its own address, so register every one. Older app versions, and apps whose sign-in is not started from Resgrid, use these.

data.name: SsoEditIdpSsoUrlNote
data.value: The IdP's SAML sign-in address (HTTP-Redirect binding). Needed for sign-in started from the Resgrid apps and website.

data.name: SsoEditIdpCertNote
data.value: Encrypted at rest. Leave blank to keep the existing certificate.

data.name: SsoEditSigningKeyNote
data.value: Encrypted at rest. Leave blank if your IdP does not require signed requests.

data.name: SsoEditAttrMapDescription
data.value: Map claim names your IdP sends to the Resgrid user fields. Leave blank to use the standard claim URIs automatically. The value is the claim name as emitted by your IdP.

data.name: SsoEditAttrMapJsonNote
data.value: Must be valid JSON. Use the quick-fill buttons on the right.

data.name: SsoEditQuickFillDescription
data.value: Click to auto-fill the mapping JSON with known defaults for your IdP.

data.name: ScimSetupTokenWarningTitle
data.value: Important — Copy your SCIM Bearer Token Now

data.name: ScimSetupTokenWarningBody
data.value: This token is displayed only once and cannot be retrieved again. Copy it immediately and paste it into your identity provider's SCIM configuration. If you lose it, click Rotate Token to generate a new one.

data.name: ScimSetupTokenEncryptedNote
data.value: This token is stored encrypted in the Resgrid database using your department-specific encryption key.

data.name: ScimSetupRotateTokenNote
data.value: Rotating generates a new token and invalidates the old one.

data.name: ScimSetupRotateTokenConfirm
data.value: Are you sure? Any existing SCIM integration will break until you update the token in your IdP.

data.name: ScimSetupConnectorDescription
data.value: Enter these values into your identity provider's SCIM provisioning configuration.

data.name: ScimSetupGenericHeader
data.value: Any SCIM 2.0 compatible client can be configured with the following:

data.name: SsoScimApiReferenceDescription
data.value: Your identity provider calls these endpoints using HTTP Bearer Token authentication. All requests must include the authorization header and the department identifier header shown below.

data.name: SsoScimDeptHeaderNote
data.value: Required on every request so Resgrid can route to the correct department.

data.name: SsoScimGetUserDesc
data.value: Get a single user by SCIM ID

data.name: SsoScimProvisionTokenDescription
data.value: Generate or rotate the bearer token that your identity provider uses to authenticate SCIM requests. The token is shown only once — copy it before closing this dialog.

data.name: SsoScimTokenModalWarning
data.value: This token is shown only once and cannot be retrieved again. Copy it now and paste it into your identity provider's SCIM configuration.

data.name: SsoScimTokenModalRotateConfirm
data.value: Rotating the token will immediately invalidate the current token. Any active SCIM sync will fail until you update the token in your IdP. Continue?

data.name: SsoScimTokenModalProvisionConfirm
data.value: This will generate a new SCIM bearer token for this configuration. Copy and store it securely — it will only be shown once. Continue?

data.name: SsoScimTokenEncryptedNote
data.value: Stored encrypted in the Resgrid database using your department-specific key.

data.name: SsoScimSetupPageNote
data.value: For step-by-step IdP-specific instructions (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace) and token management, visit the SCIM Setup page for each configuration.

data.name: SecurityPolicyNoSsoWarning
data.value: No active SSO configuration. You can configure password policies below, but Require SSO cannot be enabled until you have an active SSO configuration.

data.name: SecurityPolicyRequireMfaNote
data.value: Members who have not enrolled in MFA will be prompted to do so on next login.

data.name: SecurityPolicyRequireSsoWarning
data.value: Warning: Enabling this blocks all username/password logins. Ensure at least one admin has tested SSO login successfully before enabling.

data.name: SecurityPolicyIpRangesNote
data.value: One CIDR block per line, or comma-separated. Empty = allow all. Logins from outside these ranges will be denied.

data.name: SecurityPolicyDataClassNote
data.value: Used for compliance reporting and audit logs.

data.name: SecurityPolicyPasswordInfoAlert
data.value: Password policies apply to local (non-SSO) logins only. If you enable Require SSO above, these settings have no effect.

data.name: SecurityPolicyPasswordExpirationNote
data.value: 0 = passwords never expire. 90 is typical for CUI environments.

data.name: SecurityPolicyMinPasswordLengthNote
data.value: Minimum 8 (system default). Department policies may only increase this. NIST recommends 12+; CUI requires 14+.

data.name: SecurityPolicySystemComplexityNote
data.value: All Resgrid accounts are required to meet the following password complexity standard. This cannot be disabled by department policy.

data.name: SecurityPolicyComplexityRule1
data.value: At least 8 characters (or the department minimum length above)

data.name: SecurityPolicyComplexityRule3
data.value: At least one uppercase and one lowercase letter

data.name: SecurityPolicyPasswordComplexityNote
data.value: Enforces at least one uppercase letter, one digit, and one special character.

data.name: SecurityPolicyCannotEnableRequireSso
data.value: Cannot enable SSO-only login: no active SSO configuration exists. Create and enable an SSO configuration first.

data.name: PwdErrorNoDigit
data.value: Password must contain at least one digit (number).

data.name: PwdErrorNoUppercase
data.value: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter.

data.name: PwdErrorNoLowercase
data.value: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter.

data.name: PwdErrorTooShort
data.value: Password must be at least {0} characters long.

data.name: PwdMinLengthTooLow
data.value: Minimum password length cannot be less than the system default of 8 characters.

data.name: PermDeleteLogNote
data.value: Who in your department is allowed to delete log entries

data.name: PermUseCalendarSyncNote
data.value: Controls who can activate and use calendar subscription URLs to sync Resgrid calendar events to external calendar applications.

data.name: PermDispatchAppLoginNote
data.value: Controls who can sign in to the Dispatch app. Dispatch shows private command, unit and responder communications for every incident, so restrict this if your members are not all dispatchers.

data.name: PermCommandAppLoginNote
data.value: Controls who can act as a commander: sign in to the IC app, establish incident command on a call, and view command boards. Narrowing this beyond Everyone also lets the people you pick help work any command board (assign and move resources, run timers and accountability) without holding an ICS position on it — useful for giving dispatchers a hand in the Dispatch app. While set to Everyone, board actions stay limited to the incident commander and assigned ICS roles.

data.name: PermAdpSectionNote
data.value: When the Advanced Data Protection add-on is active, these two permissions decide who may receive protected call details by SMS or voice after entering their PIN, and who may change how protected content leaves Resgrid. Revealing or editing protected data on screen follows each page's own access rules plus a recent two-factor verification. Unlike most Resgrid permissions, unset values default to the selection shown.

data.name: PermAdpManageNote
data.value: Who can change Advanced Data Protection settings such as the verification window and notification content options. Purchasing, enrollment and cancellation always remain restricted to the department managing member.

data.name: PermAdpViewCallNote
data.value: Who may receive protected call details (nature, address, contact info, notes) by SMS or voice after entering their PIN, when PIN release is turned on. On-screen and app reveal follows call access plus two-factor verification. Defaults to Everyone because responding personnel must be able to read a dispatch.

data.name: PermAdpEditCallNote
data.value: Who can edit protected call fields after two-factor verification. Defaults to Everyone to match the normal call workflow.

data.name: PermAdpViewPersonnelNote
data.value: Who can reveal protected personnel information (employee IDs, emergency contacts) after two-factor verification. Defaults to Department Admins.

data.name: PermAdpViewContactNote
data.value: Who can reveal protected contact information (names, phone numbers, government IDs, locations) after two-factor verification. Defaults to Department Admins.

data.name: PermAdpViewOperationalNote
data.value: Who can reveal protected operational content (logs, form submissions, incident command notes and attachments) after two-factor verification. Defaults to Department and Group Admins.

data.name: PermAdpExportNote
data.value: Who can export data containing protected fields. Exports leave the protection of Resgrid, so every export is separately audited. Defaults to Department Admins; Everyone is deliberately not offered.

data.name: PermAdpEgressNote
data.value: Who can change how protected content leaves Resgrid over push, SMS, email and voice. Defaults to Department Admins; Everyone is deliberately not offered.

data.name: PermAdpBreakGlassNote
data.value: Who may use the audited emergency access path for protected data. It only works if break-glass is enabled in the department protection policy, requires a recorded reason, and notifies the department. Defaults to Department Admins; Everyone is deliberately not offered.

data.name: PermRecordsSectionNote
data.value: These permissions control the Records module, the successor to Logs. As with most Resgrid permissions, an unset row falls through to the default shown, which matches how Logs behave today. Activating Records for your department also copies your Create Log and Delete Log settings onto the matching rows unless you have already set them here.

data.name: PermRecordsNotActivatedNote
data.value: Records is not active for this department yet. You can prepare these settings now; they take effect once Records is activated.

data.name: PermRecordsCreateRecordNote
data.value: Who can author new records and edit their own drafts. Matches Create Log until you change it.

data.name: PermRecordsDeleteRecordNote
data.value: Who can cancel a draft or void a finalized record. Voiding keeps the record and its history; nothing is deleted. Matches Delete Log until you change it.

data.name: PermRecordsReviewRecordsNote
data.value: Who can review records submitted for review and return them for correction. Group Only limits group admins to records from their own group.

data.name: PermRecordsApproveRecordsNote
data.value: Who can approve a reviewed record before it is finalized, for record types that use the approval lifecycle.

data.name: PermRecordsFinalizeRecordsNote
data.value: Who can finalize a record, which assigns its record number and locks its content. Quick Entry record types finalize on save, so this matches Create Log until you change it.

data.name: PermRecordsAmendRecordsNote
data.value: Who can open an amendment on a finalized record. An amendment creates a new revision; the original revision stays intact.

data.name: PermRecordsSubmitRecordsNote
data.value: Who can submit a finalized record to an external reporting destination such as a state or national system.

data.name: PermRecordsExportRecordsNote
data.value: Who can print a record or export a list of records.

data.name: PermRecordsShareRecordsExternallyNote
data.value: Who can share a record with other groups in the department or with people outside it.

data.name: PermRecordsViewRestrictedRecordsNote
data.value: Who can read the restricted sections of a record, such as the details on a coroner record. Everyone else sees that the section exists but not its contents.

data.name: PermRecordsViewLegacyRecordsNote
data.value: Who can read the read-only Logs history from before Records was activated.

data.name: PermRecordsViewGroupRecordsNote
data.value: Whether personnel can see records that belong to other groups. Tick Group Only and set Records Settings to group-scoped visibility to limit people to their own group's records. Leave it unrestricted to keep the department-wide view Logs has today.

data.name: PermRecordsManageRecordDefinitionsNote
data.value: Who can create and edit record definitions, the forms that records are built from.

data.name: PermRecordsPublishRecordDefinitionsNote
data.value: Who can publish a record definition version so it can be used for new records.

data.name: PermRecordsManageRecordReportsNote
data.value: Who can create and edit saved record reports and their schedules.

data.name: PermRecordsManageRecordDisclosuresNote
data.value: Who can prepare and release public-records disclosure packages.

data.name: PermRecordsManageRecordLegalHoldNote
data.value: Who can place and release legal holds, which suspend retention and prevent a record from being voided.

data.name: PermRecordsReassignRecordDraftsNote
data.value: Who can move a draft record to a different author, for example when the original author is unavailable.

data.name: PermRecordsRecordsPreventionAdminNote
data.value: Who can create and change occupancies, inspection programs and code sets, hydrants, permits and community risk reduction activities. Reading prevention data needs only Records access; investigations are governed by the restricted-records permission plus case membership.

data.name: PermRecordsIssueInventoryNote
data.value: Controls who can issue and return inventory. Defaults to department administrators.

data.name: PermRecordsManageControlledSubstancesNote
data.value: Controls who can record and witness controlled-substance transactions. Defaults to department administrators. A different authorized person must witness each transaction.

data.name: PermRecordsTransferInventoryNote
data.value: Controls who can transfer inventory between locations. Defaults to department administrators.

data.name: SecurityPolicyMfaMethodsIntro
data.value: Choose which verification methods count as multi-factor authentication in this department. Authenticator app (TOTP) codes are always accepted, so turning a method off never locks anyone out; members who used it are asked to verify again.

data.name: SecurityPolicyMfaMethodsManagingMemberOnly
data.value: Only the department's managing member can change these settings.

data.name: SecurityPolicyMfaMethodsNotYetAvailable
data.value: Passkeys are not yet available on this system. These choices take effect when they are.

data.name: SecurityPolicyAllowPasskeysForLoginMfaLabel
data.value: Accept passkeys for sign-in and security checks

data.name: SecurityPolicyAllowPasskeysForLoginMfaNote
data.value: A passkey registered in the same app counts as MFA for sign-in, switching departments, and sensitive actions.

data.name: SecurityPolicyAllowPasskeysForAdpNote
data.value: A passkey counts as MFA for revealing and editing protected data. Changing this ends current protected-data access, so members verify again.

data.name: SecurityPolicyAllowResponderApprovalLabel
data.value: Accept approval from the Responder app

data.name: SecurityPolicyAllowResponderApprovalNote
data.value: Where passkeys are accepted, a member can approve a sign-in or protected-data request with the passkey in their Responder app. Never used for security changes. Changing this ends current protected-data access.

data.name: SecurityPolicyAllowFederatedMfaForLoginMfaLabel
data.value: Accept your identity provider's MFA for sign-in and security checks

data.name: SecurityPolicyAllowFederatedMfaForLoginMfaNote
data.value: Requires a tested MFA mapping on your SSO configuration.

data.name: SecurityPolicyAllowFederatedMfaForAdpLabel
data.value: Accept your identity provider's MFA for protected data

data.name: SecurityPolicyAllowFederatedMfaForAdpNote
data.value: Requires a tested MFA mapping on your SSO configuration. Changing this ends current protected-data access.

data.name: SecurityPolicyFederatedMappingUntested
data.value: Your SSO configuration has no tested MFA mapping. Save a mapping and complete its test before accepting your identity provider's MFA.

data.name: SecurityPolicyFederatedNeedsResgridMfa
data.value: To accept your identity provider's MFA, first verify with your authenticator app or a passkey. Identity provider MFA cannot approve this change.

data.name: SecurityPolicyAcceptRecentLoginMfaForAdpLabel
data.value: Let a recent sign-in verification open protected data

data.name: SecurityPolicyAcceptRecentLoginMfaForAdpNote
data.value: Members who verified MFA when signing in do not have to verify again to reveal protected data within the step-up window. Changing this ends current protected-data access.

data.name: SecurityPolicyAcceptRecentUnlockMfaForAdpLabel
data.value: Let a shared-device unlock open protected data

data.name: SecurityPolicyAcceptRecentUnlockMfaForAdpNote
data.value: On shared vehicle tablets and workstations, the operator's fresh unlock verification counts for revealing protected data. Changing this ends current protected-data access.

data.name: SecurityPolicySharedDevicesIntro
data.value: Shared vehicle tablets and dispatch workstations lock when no one uses them and end with the shift. Operators unlock with their own authenticator app, passkey or Responder approval, never a password kept on the device. A stricter value here also applies to sessions already running.

data.name: SecurityPolicySharedDevicesManagingMemberOnly
data.value: Only the department's managing member can change the shared-device policy.

data.name: SecurityPolicySharedDevicesNotYetAvailable
data.value: Shared-device mode is not available on this deployment yet. These values are kept, and it cannot be required for another app until it is.

data.name: SecurityPolicySharedIdleLockLabel
data.value: Lock after this many idle minutes

data.name: SecurityPolicySharedIdleLockNote
data.value: 1 to {0} minutes. Only the operator's own activity counts; background updates and incoming alerts do not.

data.name: SecurityPolicySharedShiftLabel
data.value: End the shift after this many hours

data.name: SecurityPolicySharedShiftNote
data.value: 1 to {0} hours after sign-in, whatever the activity. The next shift signs in again.

data.name: SecurityPolicySharedRequiredNote
data.value: Sessions of these apps in this department always lock when idle and end with the shift, whatever the installation is set to. Sign-ins that do not say which app they are count too, so integrations that sign in with a password also lock. Use app versions that support shared mode.

data.name: SecurityPolicySharedIdleOutOfRange
data.value: Choose an idle lock from 1 to {0} minutes.

data.name: SecurityPolicySharedShiftOutOfRange
data.value: Choose a shift length from 1 to {0} hours.

data.name: SecurityPolicySharedRequirementUnavailable
data.value: Shared-device mode is not available on this deployment yet, so it cannot be required for another app.

data.name: FederatedMfaIntro
data.value: Tell Resgrid how your identity provider reports that it verified a member with MFA. Where this department accepts your identity provider's MFA, a sign-in or verification that carries one of these values counts as MFA, and members need no Resgrid authenticator for it. Every change must pass a test sign-in before it takes effect.

data.name: FederatedMfaNoSso
data.value: Set up and enable an SSO configuration first.

data.name: FederatedMfaStatusUntested
data.value: Not in effect: version {0} has not passed its test yet.

data.name: FederatedMfaValuesNote
data.value: One value per line. Values are matched exactly, including case. A response needs at least one listed value.

data.name: FederatedMfaSaved
data.value: Mapping saved. It takes effect once it passes a test sign-in.

data.name: FederatedMfaRemoved
data.value: Mapping removed. Your identity provider's MFA no longer counts in this department.

data.name: FederatedMfaNeedsResgridMfa
data.value: Changing the mapping needs a recent verification with your authenticator app or a passkey. Your identity provider's MFA cannot approve this change.

data.name: FederatedMfaTestNote
data.value: The test sends you to your identity provider now, asking for MFA. When it returns a value the mapping counts, this version takes effect.
